note: Known failures in this alpha. The Python ones depend on the originating deployment's host (Windows interop, live Claude/Composio/Drive state) and also fail in its own tree; none is caused by a known defect in Core's own logic.
frontend_node_tests: SEO follows the visible service name and description; URL and IDs never change
Stage 1.5 drafts migrate: same IDs, text, order, styles; links take original destinations
add, duplicate and edit only the copy; move and remove independently
default SEO equals the original metadata and JSON-LD of every page
every genuine fixture and historical proof draft migrates deterministically, purely and idempotently
genuinely unsupported values are retained verbatim, survive edits and exports, and are never rendered
owner edits carry to the field with the same meaning; untouched text takes the new source
page styles are scoped and relative to the Shared site design; legacy full designs keep only real edits
published-page draft renders literal text, keeps live structure, and blocks active content
real-site adapter renders every instance from its template with its own text, links, styles and anchors
the shared upload mechanism is exposed once, sending real bytes via FormData
the spec is consistent with both snapshots: destinations exist, unchanged types are byte-identical
unchanged text keeps the source text-node segments; edited text replaces them
v1 browser drafts migrate without losing text/order; v2 includes source provenance
v3 migration is idempotent, pure, carries the caption and layout, retains the uploaded image and keeps styles
